newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Dairy Board signs NZ$40 mln pizza cheese deal.
newsitem.headline: NZ Dairy Board signs NZ$40 mln pizza cheese deal.

text.p: The New Zealand Dairy Board said on Thursday it had secured a NZ$40 million contract to supply mozzarella cheese to the world's largest pizza chain, Pizza Hut.

Under the contract the board, which supplied mozzarella -- a stretched curd cheese -- to Pizza Hut franchises in 10 countries in 1996, will supply twice as many markets, including the Middle East and five new markets in the Asia-Pacific region.
The cheese, made at the Kiwi Co-operative Dairy plant in Taranaki, is quick-frozen and shredded at the Grated Cheese Company in Auckland.
